name: motley-fool-scraper
what_it_holds: Selenium/webdriver-manager Python scraper (Python 3.7+) for Motley Fool earnings transcripts, built as a 2022 FAU web-scraping workshop exercise. BSD-2-Clause license, 10 commits, last updated Dec 2022. No committed sample data. README explicitly notes fool.com's Terms of Use prohibit scraping and warns not to abuse it.
why_useful: A minimal, permissively-licensed reference scraper pattern for Motley Fool transcripts; useful only as a documented method, not to be run, since fool.com ToS forbids scraping (a human ToS call per project rule 6).
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora

name: sec-api-node
what_it_holds: Node.js SDK (310 stars, updated 3 Sep 2026) wrapping the commercial sec-api.io service: full-text search, XBRL-to-JSON, 13F holdings, insider (Form 4) trades, financial statements, exec comp, material contracts, registration statements, bond/credit agreements, proxy voting, enforcement actions, real-time filing streaming. Requires a paid API key for most endpoints beyond a free tier.
why_useful: Reference for what fields a commercial full-text-search/XBRL API exposes (13F concentration history is gap 15); the wrapper itself is free but the underlying API needs a paid key, so only usable within the free-tier limits — flag as a method reference, not a free data source.
size_hint: SDK only; backing API is commercial/paid
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
